title: Lentil, Mushroom and Bulgur Burgers
changes_from_base: Earthy brown lentils, browned mushrooms and leek replace the black beans, bulgur soaks up spare moisture, ground cashews add savoury richness, and aquafaba with panko holds the patties together without egg.
summary: These robust patties draw on the earthy flavour of lentils, the meaty texture of mushrooms and the subtle nuttiness of bulgur.
equipment: rimmed baking tray lined with kitchen paper
wire rack set in a baking tray

ingredients.item: brown lentils, picked over and rinsed
fine sea salt or table salt
ingredients.note: about ½ tsp, for cooking the lentils

ingredients.item: vegetable oil, plus a little extra if needed
chestnut mushrooms, trimmed and thinly sliced
small celery stick, very finely chopped
small leek, white and pale green part only, finely chopped and well washed
fine sea salt or table salt
ingredients.note: about ¼ tsp, for cooking the bulgur

ingredients.item: aquafaba (the liquid from a tin of chickpeas)
fine sea salt or table salt
ingredients.note: about ½ tsp, for the patty mixture

steps.title: Boil
steps.text: Bring 75 g brown lentils with 700 ml water and ½ tsp salt to the boil, then simmer for about 25 min until just starting to break up; drain and spread on a lined tray to cool and dry.

steps.title: Sauté
steps.text: Heat 1 tbsp vegetable oil in a large frying pan over medium and cook 225 g sliced chestnut mushrooms for about 12 min until golden, then add 1 medium finely chopped onion, 1 small finely chopped celery stick, ½ small finely chopped leek and 1 finely chopped garlic clove, cooking for 10-15 min until browned; spread on the tray with the lentils and leave to cool completely, about 30 min.

steps.title: Prepare
steps.text: Cover 65 g medium-grind bulgur wheat with 480 ml water and ¼ tsp salt in a microwave-safe bowl, cover and microwave for about 5 min until soft, then drain through a fine sieve and press out the excess water.

steps.title: Pulse
steps.text: Grind 70 g raw unsalted cashews in a food processor until finely ground.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Mix the cooled lentils, bulgur, cashews and 40 ml aquafaba together, then pulse in 2 batches until coarse but holding together; stir in 55 g panko breadcrumbs and ½ tsp salt.

steps.title: Form
steps.text: Shape the mixture into 6 patties each about 10 cm wide.

steps.title: Fry
steps.text: Cook the patties in 2 batches with 1 tbsp oil each over medium for about 4 min per side until crisp and well browned, keeping them warm on a wire rack in a low oven.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Place each patty into a burger bun.

tips: Cook the lentils until just tender but still whole; mushy lentils make a pasty burger without any bite.
Ensure the mushrooms are thoroughly browned to develop depth of flavour
Pat the drained lentils dry on a lined tray so the mixture is not soggy
safety: These contain cashews and celery, so check before serving anyone with those allergies
storage: The patties keep chilled for 2 days. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
